components.name: Mascot
components.description: The BEK mascot — a panda. Pose: idle + 8 gaze directions + 9 emotions. Size: XS 32 · S 48 · M 64 · L 96 · XL 140 · 2XL 200 (size/mascot/1–6). Source: page-mascot (MIT © Kamran Ahmed). Always used with text; one mascot per screen.

components.name: Mascot message

Description.default: Add your first course — your learning history will appear here.

components.description: Mascot + title + description + optional button. For empty-state, error and success screens. The mascot pose is chosen from the nested instance (exposed).

2.3 Mascot.text:
Anatomy
The mascot is not a drawing but a frame cropped from a sprite sheet. The component is a single frame with no background and an image fill (CROP). Frame 360×360 px, a 1/3 × 1/3 slice of the sheet (via image transform). Surface: transparent background. Shadow drawn into the frame. Size: width = height = scale/32 … scale/200 (bound to the token). Source sheet: directions — 9 gazes · reactions — 9 emotions.
Variants — emotion families: Gaze directions (interactive mode looks towards the cursor; static uses only idle): idle, look-up-left, look-up, look-up-right, look-left, look-right, look-down-left, look-down, look-down-right. Positive (success, thanks, greetings, achievement): happy, love, success, celebrate, wink (+ waving planned). Neutral (announcements, attention, gentle apology): surprised, shy (+ thinking, confused planned). Negative / low energy (empty state, error, disconnection): sleepy, dizzy (+ sad planned).
Sizes: XS 32 chat, inline · S 48 toast, list item · M 64 card, inline message · L 96 empty state · XL 140 hero, onboarding · 2XL 200 404, full screen. Minimum XS 32.
States and surfaces: no state axis; behaviour in code — static (default, no JS) or interactive (follows cursor, reacts 0.5 s when clicked; landing, onboarding and 404 only). Dark: use neutral/muted/hover (fill/tertiary-hover) or a lighter surface — on the darkest surface the ears blend in.
Use cases (Mascot message): Empty state → sleepy · Error / 404 → dizzy · Success → success · Onboarding → wink · New feature → surprised · Thanks / favourite → love.
Props: Pose (Variant, default idle) · Size (Variant, default L) · interactive (code, boolean, default false: page-mascot follows cursor + reacts) · label (code, string: omitted → decorative aria-hidden; standalone/interactive → "BEK panda") · Mascot message · Layout: Stacked · Inline (default Stacked) · Title / Description (Text) · Action (Boolean, default true) · mascot (exposed instance, default sleepy · L).
Tokens: Mascot width/height scale/32 · 48 · 64 · 96 · 140 · 200 (scope WIDTH_HEIGHT). Mascot colour/background — image fill, colours never changed, transparent background. Message padding scale/32. Message gap (mascot ↔ text, text ↔ button) scale/24. Title ↔ Description scale/8. Title: Title/L · text/primary. Description: Body/S · text/secondary. Action: Button · Variant=Action · Size=M. Dark surface: fill/tertiary-hover and lighter.
Do / Don't: the mascot always comes with text — the mascot carries the emotion, the text carries the meaning. Don't mix several mascots or different emotions on one screen. The emotion fits the context: dizzy for errors, success for achievements.
